rationale: Several papers, such as [2501.16087], [2501.07407], [2607.06671], [2402.16529], [2505.09355], [2609.19108], and [2605.28676], provide substantive new evidence on the role of magnetic fields in the evolution and stability of accretion disks around black holes, addressing various aspects like stability, jet formation, and magnetic field configurations. However, the question is not fully settled as these studies contribute to different parts of the broader question.
